subject: SOC2 evidence intake — SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts (proofpack request)
messages:
From: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@medisyshealth.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@medisyshealth.com
Date: 2026-05-14T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 evidence request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC

Hi Priyom,

We're kicking off our SOC 2 evidence collection for Q2 and our external auditor (Kestrel & Co.) requested a small ProofPack focused on identity & access controls for the Redwood tenant powering several integrations. Specifically they asked for: 

- 2–3 redacted SAML assertion examples (showing NameID, attributes, audience, timestamps)
- SCIM delta extract covering 2026-03-01 -> 2026-04-30 (user add/modify/delete events)
- A current RBAC role matrix mapping roles to privileges and a short note on least-privilege enforcement
- Any short runbook explaining automated user provisioning behavior and owner contacts

Can you confirm Redwood can deliver these artifacts and the expected delivery timeline? Auditor preference is machine-readable CSV/JSON for logs and XLSX for the role matrix. They asked to receive materials within 5 business days if possible.

Also flag if any of these items contain PII so we can coordinate redaction.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Turner
Senior IT Compliance Manager
MediSys Health

Attachment: SOC2_Evidence_Request_050726.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@medisyshealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC

Hi Alicia — thanks for the detail and the deadline. We can produce the requested proofpack. High-level plan: 

- SAML assertions: we'll pick 3 redacted examples (one successful login, one SSO fail-to-redirect, one assertion showing group/role claim). Format: .eml and a short plain-text extraction of key attributes.
- SCIM deltas: export CSV with timestamps and op type (ADD/MOD/DEL) for 2026-03-01 through 2026-04-30. We will tag system-of-record IDs and remove any personal contact fields you don't need.
- RBAC matrix: XLSX mapping Redwood roles -> model access / console privileges + last owner.
- Runbook: a 1-page Markdown/PDF describing provisioning flow (SCIM connector, mapping rules, owner contacts).

Couple of clarifying q's: 1) Do you need raw assertion JWTs, or are redacted header+payload extracts sufficient? 2) Any required anonymization standard (e.g., replace email with user-<id>@redacted)?

Internally I'll coordinate the exports and target a first drop by 2026-05-18 EOD. If Kestrel needs earlier, let me know and we'll push. We'll place artifacts in a shared Drive folder and share a link with your team.

I'll loop in my infra and CS colleagues to pull the SCIM and SAML samples.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: ACTION: MediSys SOC2 proofpack — SSO/SCIM/RBAC (deliver by 2026-05-18)

Jonas / Marissa — please see the auditor ask below (excerpted). MediSys needs a short proofpack for SSO/SCIM/RBAC with a target drop by 2026-05-18 EOD. Can you take ownership of the items below? I'm copying the artifacts we should produce in the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Proofpack_MediSys_May2026 (I'll create the folder and grant ACLs).

Responsibilities:
- Jonas: export 3 SAML assertion samples (eml + extracted attributes). Ensure we redact any full email addresses per guidance below and strip long session cookies. Put samples in Drive + include a brief note on how assertions were captured.
- Marissa: coordinate SCIM delta export for 2026-03-01 -> 2026-04-30 (CSV). Include columns: timestamp, op_type, user_id, user_external_id, changed_fields. Confirm if support needs to redact contact fields; default to user-<uid>@redacted for email.
- Priyom: I'll assemble RBAC role matrix XLSX and write the one-page runbook.

Redaction guidance: replace personal emails with user-<id>@redacted, leave system IDs intact. If either of you thinks anonymization will break auditor correlation, flag me immediately.

Jonas, Marissa — can you confirm ETA by EOD 2026-05-17? If either item requires escalation to Eng infra, call out exact blockers.

Excerpt from client request (Alicia):
> "...they asked for 2–3 redacted SAML assertion examples... SCIM delta extract covering 2026-03-01 -> 2026-04-30... role matrix mapping roles to privileges... within 5 business days..."

Thanks — Priyom
